title: Protocol-Governed Computing: Reference Implementation (composed platform)
description:
The composed Protocol-Governed Computing reference implementation: a single governance surface assembling seven governed domains over 404 protocol artifacts, including mutually unrelated business domains. This deposit identifies the composition — the artifact to which claims about domain independence and closure refer — rather than any single component repository. The nine component repositories are archived separately and named below as parts.

Cite this version DOI when citing the reference implementation as evidence.
notes: MANUAL DEPOSIT — not minted by the GitHub integration. Upload the assembled snapshot plus a manifest of the nine component version DOIs. After the nine per-repo releases are archived, add each as a related_identifier with relation "hasPart" before publishing. Component repos: software_governance, conformance_workloads, business_domains, protocol_compiler, snapshot_assembler, protocol_runtime, snapshot_inspector, transformation, protocol_transport.
